Monitor Assess Report Guide was a complete ecosystem for the citizens and government for road maintenance and progress checking.

The screenshots of MARG app, with stats about submitted reports and map with location of reports.

ReactTypescript 3

We incorporated a sense of ownership towards public infrastructure in the users.

We also motivated the users with the stories of others who had successfully helped the government.

I worked on the design and frontend of the application.

Gold @ InterIIT Tech 2020 in Coding Hackathon

  • We created two applications, one facing the general public and one for the officials, the screenshots above are from the public app.
  • We focused on making the dashboard inviting and engaging by gamifying several aspects of the app.
  • We added stories in spotlight to highlight the best citizens.
  • We added objectives and stats for further engagement.
  • The flow to make a report was kept as simple and intuitive as possible.
  • The dashboard facing the government officials provided them with the overview of all the reports and allowed them to filter mark and triage the reports accordingly.
  • It won the Gold at InterIIT Tech 2020 in Coding Hackathon.
  • This cheeky illustration was made by me in celebration of that win.
